from common import *

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__);save_source(TMP/'verify_v2.py')
    source_new=PRIOR/'docs/inference-study.json';source_old=PRIOR/'docs/stability-20261106-inference.json'
    controls=[x for x in read(source_new)['models'] if x['arm']=='h20'];old=read(source_old)['components']
    assert [r['seed'] for r in controls]==SEEDS and [r['seed'] for r in old]==SEEDS
    receipts=[r['prediction'] for r in controls+old]
    for r in receipts:check(r)
    existing=read(PREVIOUS/'docs/evaluation-inputs.json')
    for k in ['st_daily','regime']:check(existing[k]);receipts.append(existing[k])
    p=BASE/'docs/supplemental-control-inputs.json'
    assert not p.exists()
    write(p,{'at':time.time(),'purpose':'Explicit continuous-control prediction and actual frozen ST/style dependencies, verified against pre-existing historical source receipts before any new candidate evaluation. Adds source verification without modifying frozen science contract or inputs.','prior_sources':[fingerprint(source_new),fingerprint(source_old),fingerprint(PREVIOUS/'docs/evaluation-inputs.json')],'verified_files':receipts,'scope_gap':'Native init inputs froze model/label sources and n5/n10 signals but did not enumerate all continuous-control prediction files. This supplemental audit checks their pre-existing authoritative hashes; final verification must recheck it.'})
    review=BASE/'docs/adapter-review.json'
    write(review,{'reviewer':'/root/review_quantile_n','scope':'Read-only actual active adapters and source protocols, no training or large data verification.','result':'No deterministic normal-path change to scientific inputs, seeds, aggregation or metrics found.','findings':[{'id':'P2-partial-verification','issue':'Zero-success/early-stop cases assumed complete controls and nonempty weights','resolution':'Versioned verify_v2.py allows missing evidence only on partial path, lists missing controls, and marks training input verification false for empty scope.','verification':'Reviewer statically checked initial v2 diff; final boolean/count adjustment syntax checked. Numerical verification remains pending.'}],'excluded':['Unused prior final_report.py/cleanup_temporary.py require adaptation before use','Generic platform same-H group infrastructure','Autonomous failure closeout: root owns terminal events on observed failure','Actual model numerical and visual acceptance, promotion and production']})
    harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Supplemental continuous-control prediction and ST/style source verification recorded before new return exposure: '+str(p.relative_to(ROOT))+' SHA256 '+fingerprint(p)['sha256']+'. Read-only adapter review and versioned partial verifier are in docs/adapter-review.json; frozen scientific contract unchanged.'})
    print('Historical control sources verified and review receipt saved.')
